item.description: Kevin Doherty will be remembered for his deep love for his family, being a proud Jacksonville Jaguars fan, his resilience, and the way he always showed up for the people he cared about. Read more: Kevin Doherty

item.title: CORRECTION: Dunnellon restaurant never failed health inspection as state admits ‘clerical error’
item.description: A restaurant in Dunnellon that state records mislabeled as having closed due to a health inspection failure was, in fact, never closed, and did not fail its inspection, with the state admitting to a "clerical error" that led to the incorrect listing. Read more: CORRECTION: Dunnellon restaurant never failed health inspection as state admits ‘clerical error’

item.title: Two more Ocala shoppers sue Winn-Dixie, Harveys Supermarket following slip-and-fall incidents
